routeIdeas.title: Point Buchon
routeIdeas.character: Sea stacks, salt air & a good long walk
routeIdeas.terrain: Coastal dirt trail, uneven ground and exposed bluffs
routeIdeas.description: The coast opens up here. Sea stacks offshore, grassland beside the trail, and the Pacific keeping us company all the way. A longer walk for those happy on uneven ground.

routeIdeas.title: Cass Hill
routeIdeas.character: A little climb. A whole lot of coast.
routeIdeas.description: A bit of uphill earns a fine view: Cayucos below, Whale Rock Reservoir behind, and Morro Rock out along the coast. Take your time on the climb. There’s plenty to stop and look at.

routeIdeas.title: Fiscalini Ranch
routeIdeas.character: An unhurried morning by the water
routeIdeas.terrain: Boardwalk and gravel with gentle grades
routeIdeas.description: Follow the Bluff Trail with the ocean at your shoulder. There are handmade benches for a pause and a view worth lingering over. A gentler outing with room for a proper conversation.
